title: How Chris Kelly won bucking contests with his plunger mute
summary: Humphrey describes Chris Kelly's blues playing, his rubber mute, Leroy Evans' timekeeping and the numbers Kelly played.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
